series.name: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)
series.notes: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E — Inverter Pair Wall Mounted Type K-Series (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS K-Series, Sky Air split; PK-sold family class). High confidence (service manual). Covers 00/U/A/C/E/F/H/J/L/P letter+digit self-diagnosis codes.

meaning.en: No malfunction is stored; the unit is operating normally.
meaning.ur: Koi kharabi store nahi hai; unit aam tor par chal raha hai

causes.en: Self-diagnosis mode entered with no fault latched.
causes.ur: Khud ki diagnosis mode mein daakhil hue, magar koi fault latch nahi hua

causes.en: Previously active fault has cleared after reset.
causes.ur: Pehle se chal raha fault reset ke baad khatam ho gaya

solutions.en: No action required; exit the code-display mode.
solutions.ur: Koi karrey ki zaroorat nahi; code display mode se bahar nikal jayein.

solutions.en: If the unit still misbehaves, run normal troubleshooting.
solutions.ur: Agar unit ab bhi ghalat behaviour dikhaye to aam troubleshooting karein

notes.en: 00 = normal in every official RAC list (SM-TS3, FTXC-C OM, India/regional pages).
notes.ur: Har official RAC list mein 00 = normal hi hai (SM-TS3, FTXC-C OM, India/regional pages).

meaning.en: The system detected insufficient refrigerant charge (low gas / leak condition).
meaning.ur: System ne refrigerant ki miqdar kam payi (gas kam ya leak ki surat-e-haal)

causes.en: Refrigerant leak or undercharge after installation/service.
causes.ur: Installation ya service ke baad refrigerant leak ya kam charge

causes.en: Stop valves left closed, or relevant thermistors disconnected.
causes.ur: Stop valves band chhor diye gaye, ya zaruri thermistors disconnect kar diye gaye.

causes.en: Defective electronic expansion valve or weak compressor performance.
causes.ur: Electronic expansion valve kharab ya compressor ka performance kamzor

solutions.en: Open all stop valves; refit any disconnected thermistors.
solutions.ur: Pehle tamam stop valves kholein; khule hue thermistors dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Leak-test the circuit, repair leaks, evacuate and charge the specified amount.
solutions.ur: Circuit ka leak test karein, leak theek karein, hawa nikaal kar mujarraba miqdar refrigerant bharrein

solutions.en: If error repeats: check expansion valve, thermistors, then outdoor PCB / compressor.
solutions.ur: Agar error dobara aaye: pehle expansion valve aur thermistors check karein, phir outdoor PCB / compressor.

notes.en: Also listed on all official RAC remote tables (India, FTXC-C, web-manual).
notes.ur: Yeh sab official RAC remote tables par bhi listed hai (India, FTXC-C, web-manual).

title.ur: Voltage giri ya main circuit mein zyada voltage

meaning.en: Supply voltage dropped below or rose above the allowed window, or the detection circuit flagged it.
meaning.ur: Supply voltage mujarraba se neeche gir gaya ya us se upar chala gaya, ya detection circuit ne ise pakad liya

causes.en: Mains voltage not within specification, momentary dips or power failures.
causes.ur: Mains voltage specification ke andar nahi, lamhi ke liye giray ya bijli gayi

causes.en: Electrical noise, short inside fan-motor winding, or disconnected compressor harness.
causes.ur: Electrical noise, fan motor ki winding ke andar short, ya compressor harness disconnect

causes.en: Faulty DC/over-voltage detection circuit on outdoor or indoor PCB.
causes.ur: Condenser unit ya wall unit ke PCB par DC/over-voltage detection circuit kharab.

solutions.en: Verify mains is within rated range; fix supply/stabiliser issues.
solutions.ur: Mains rated range ke andar hai ya nahi check karein; supply/stabiliser ki masla hal karein

solutions.en: Power-cycle once the supply is stable; if it recurs, inspect detection circuitry and replace faulty PCB.
solutions.ur: Supply mustaqil ho jaye to power cycle karein; dobara aaye to detection circuit dekh kar kharab PCB badlein.

notes.en: PK grid voltage swings make this a common first-check code.
notes.ur: PK ki grid voltage ke utaar-chadhaav ki wajah se yeh pehle check karne wala aam code hai.

title.en: Signal transmission error between indoor and outdoor units
title.ur: Wall unit aur condenser unit ke darmiyan signal transmission error

meaning.en: Communication between indoor and outdoor units was lost or corrupted.
meaning.ur: Wall unit aur condenser unit ke darmiyan communication khatam ya kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Wiring error or break in the interconnect cable (F1/F2, wire No. 3).
causes.ur: Interconnect cable (F1/F2, wire No. 3) mein wiring ki ghalti ya kata hua hissa

causes.en: Outdoor unit power OFF, reduced supply voltage, or disturbed supply waveform.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ki power off, supply voltage kam, ya supply ki waveform bigdi

causes.en: Defective indoor or outdoor PCB; short inside outdoor fan-motor winding.
causes.ur: Wall unit ya condenser unit ka PCB kharab; condenser unit ke fan motor ki winding mein short

solutions.en: Check inter-unit wiring polarity/continuity and repair breaks.
solutions.ur: Units ke darmiyan wiring ki polarity/continuity check karke kata hua hissa theek karein.

solutions.en: Confirm outdoor unit is powered; reset both units after power is stable.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ko power mila hai yeh tasdeeq karein; power mustaqil hone par dono units reset karein

solutions.en: If wiring is good, replace defective indoor/outdoor PCB after checks.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek ho to checks ke baad kharab wall ya condenser unit PCB badlein.

notes.en: Highest-frequency PK service call per general technician chatter; also on every official list.
notes.ur: Technicians ki baat-cheet ke mutabiq PK mein sabse zyada aane wali service call hai; har official list par bhi maujood hai.

title.ur: Wall aur condenser unit ka combination masla (voltage/mismatch)

meaning.en: The connected indoor and outdoor units are incompatible or wired/powered incorrectly.
meaning.ur: Jo wall aur condenser unit jude hain woh aapas mein match nahi karte ya wiring/power ghalat hai.

causes.en: Wrong models interconnected.
causes.ur: Yeh ghalat models jode gaye hain.

causes.en: Wrong connecting-wire routing or wrong PCB fitted.
causes.ur: Connecting wire ka rasta ghalat ya ghalat PCB lagaya gaya

causes.en: Defective indoor or outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Wall ya condenser unit ka PCB kharab

solutions.en: Verify model compatibility against the installation manual pairing table.
solutions.ur: Installation manual ki pairing table se model ki compatibility check karein

solutions.en: Correct the inter-unit wiring and replace any wrong/defective PCB.
solutions.ur: Inter-unit wiring theek karein aur ghalat/kharab PCB badal dein.

notes.en: Regional official pages word this as 'indoor-outdoor unit combination fault'.
notes.ur: Regional official pages par isay 'unit combination fault' likha gaya hai, yaani wall aur condenser unit ki combination na mile.

meaning.en: The indoor unit control board failed its internal self-check.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit ka control board apna self-check nahi kar paya.

causes.en: Mismatched indoor/outdoor model combination.
causes.ur: Wall aur condenser unit ke model ka combination match nahi karta

causes.en: Loose/disconnected connectors or reduced supply voltage.
causes.ur: Connector dhile ya khule hue, ya supply voltage kam

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Confirm compatible pairing; reseat terminal-board connectors.
solutions.ur: Pairing ke mutabiq tasdeeq karein; terminal board ke connector phir se lagayein.

solutions.en: Check rated voltage at the board; if error repeats, replace the indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Board par rated voltage check karein; error phir aaye to indoor PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 adds 'external factor (noise)' as a trigger.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein 'external factor (noise)' ko bhi trigger ke tor par shamil kiya gaya hai.

title.ur: Cooling mein jam par protection / heating peak-cut control

meaning.en: The unit halted because the indoor heat exchanger went below 0°C in cooling (or above the heating peak-cut limit).
meaning.ur: Cooling mein indoor heat exchanger 0°C se neeche chala gaya (ya heating peak-cut limit se upar), is liye unit ruk gayi.

causes.en: Short-circuited airflow or clogged indoor air filter.
causes.ur: Airflow band (short) ya indoor ka air filter ghad gaya

causes.en: Dust build-up on the indoor heat exchanger.
causes.ur: Indoor heat exchanger par dhool jama ho gayi

causes.en: Defective indoor heat exchanger thermistor or indoor PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor heat exchanger thermistor ya indoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Clear obstructions, wash the filter, and clean the indoor heat exchanger.
solutions.ur: Rokawat hataein, filter dhoyein aur indoor heat exchanger saaf karein.

solutions.en: Let the coil thaw, then restart; if it repeats, replace the thermistor or indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Coil ka frost (barf) khilne dein, phir restart karein; phir bhi aaye to thermistor ya indoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Regional pages shorten this to 'high pressure control or freeze-up protector'.
notes.ur: Regional pages par isay chhota kar ke 'high pressure control or freeze-up protector' likha gaya hai.

meaning.en: Indoor fan speed feedback stayed far below the commanded speed.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan ka speed feedback commanded speed se kaafi neeche reh gaya

causes.en: Noticeable drop in supply voltage.
causes.ur: Supply voltage mein nazar aani wala kami

causes.en: Winding short/broken wire inside the fan motor or its lead wires.
causes.ur: Fan motor ya uski lead wires ke andar winding short ya wire tooti hai

causes.en: Defective fan capacitor or indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Fan capacitor ya indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check voltage within ±10% of rated; spin the fan by hand for jamming.
solutions.ur: Voltage rated ke ±10% ke andar hai ya nahi check karein; fan ko haath se ghumayein ke jam to nahi.

solutions.en: Verify motor supplies (310–340 VDC, 15 VDC control); replace motor or indoor PCB as indicated.
solutions.ur: Motor ke supply (310–340 VDC, 15 VDC control) naap lein; masle ke mutabiq motor ya indoor PCB badlein.

meaning.en: The indoor coil temperature sensor read out of range (open/short).
meaning.ur: Indoor coil ke temperature sensor ki reading had se bahar hai (khuli/short).

causes.en: Thermistor connector not seated.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connector theek se baitha nahi

causes.en: Defective indoor heat exchanger thermistor.
causes.ur: Indoor heat exchanger thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the connector and re-check.
solutions.ur: Connector dobara baitha karein aur dobara check karein

solutions.en: Measure thermistor resistance against the characteristic chart; replace if off.
solutions.ur: Thermistor ka resistance characteristic chart se naaphein; ghalat nikle to badlein

solutions.en: If sensor and wiring are good, replace the indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Sensor aur wiring theek ho to indoor PCB badlein

notes.en: FTXC-C wording: 'Indoor heat exchanger (1) thermistor short / open'.
notes.ur: FTXC-C ki wording yeh hai: 'Indoor heat exchanger (1) thermistor short / open'.

meaning.en: The indoor room-temperature sensor read out of range.
meaning.ur: Indoor ka room temperature sensor ghalat reading de raha hai

causes.en: Thermistor connector not seated.
causes.ur: Thermistor connector theek se baitha nahi

causes.en: Defective room/suction-air thermistor.
causes.ur: Room/suction air ka thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reconnect the sensor plug and verify reading.
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug dobara lagayein aur reading check karein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor if resistance is off-spec; otherwise replace indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Resistance ghalat nikle to thermistor badlein, warna indoor PCB badlein

notes.en: FTXC-C: 'Indoor room thermistor short / open'.
notes.ur: FTXC-C mein yeh likha hai: 'Indoor room thermistor short / open'.

meaning.en: The outdoor unit control board failed its internal check.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ka control board apna internal check nahi kar paya.

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

causes.en: Broken harness between PCBs.
causes.ur: Do PCB ke darmiyan harness toota/khula

causes.en: Noise, momentary voltage fall, or momentary power failure.
causes.ur: Noise, lamhi ke liye voltage girna, ya lamhi ke liye bijli chali jana

solutions.en: Inspect and refit inter-board harnesses.
solutions.ur: Board ke darmiyan harness check karke phir se laga dein

solutions.en: Reset after stable power; replace outdoor PCB if the fault persists.
solutions.ur: Power mustaqil hone ke baad reset karein; fault uske baad bhi rahe to outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Third-party pages that call E1 'high pressure' are wrong (quarantined).
notes.ur: Jo third-party pages E1 ko 'high pressure' kehte hain woh ghalat hain (unhe quarantine kiya gaya hai).

meaning.en: The compressor overload protector tripped or its circuit was interrupted.
meaning.ur: Compressor ke overload protector ne trip kiya ya uski circuit mein rukaawat aa gayi

causes.en: OL device terminals disconnected, OL defective, or OL harness broken.
causes.ur: OL device ke terminals khule hue, OL kharab, ya OL harness toota

causes.en: Discharge-pipe thermistor disconnected/defective; connector S40 loose.
causes.ur: Discharge-pipe thermistor khula/kharab hai; connector S40 dhila hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage, moisture in circuit, closed stop valve, or defective EXV / four-way valve coil / outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Refrigerant ki kami, circuit mein namak, band stop valve, ya kharab EXV / four-way valve coil / outdoor PCB

solutions.en: Check OL continuity and connectors; repair or replace the OL harness/device.
solutions.ur: OL ki continuity aur connector check karein; OL harness/device theek karein ya badlein

solutions.en: Open stop valves, leak/moisture-test and recharge if gas is low.
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein, leak/namak test karein aur gas kam ho to dobara bharrein

solutions.en: Verify EXV and four-way valve coils; replace outdoor PCB if all else is good.
solutions.ur: EXV aur four-way valve ki coils check karein; baqi sab theek ho to outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: SM-TS3 phrase: 'inverter compressor motor or overheat lock'.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 ka phrase yeh hai: 'inverter compressor motor or overheat lock'.

meaning.en: The compressor failed to start or is mechanically locked.
meaning.ur: Compressor start nahi hua ya mechanically jam gaya hai

causes.en: Compressor mechanically locked.
causes.ur: Compressor mechanically jam gaya

causes.en: Compressor harness disconnected.
causes.ur: Compressor harness khula/disconnect ho gaya

solutions.en: Inspect and reconnect/replace the compressor harness.
solutions.ur: Compressor harness check karke dobara lagayein ya badlein

solutions.en: Verify power module output; replace the compressor if it will not free.
solutions.ur: Power module ka output check karein; compressor khul na raha ho to badlein

notes.en: SM-TS3 also lists 'stop valve not opened' and defective control PCB for STD-compressor overcurrent/lock variants.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 STD-compressor overcurrent/lock variants ke liye 'stop valve not opened' aur kharab control PCB ko bhi list karta hai.

meaning.en: The outdoor fan motor is not rotating as commanded.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan motor command ke mutabiq nahi ghoom raha

causes.en: Fan-motor connector disconnected.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka connector disconnect ho gaya

causes.en: Foreign object stuck in the fan.
causes.ur: Fan mein koi ajnabi cheez phansi hui hai.

causes.en: Defective outdoor fan motor or outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor ya outdoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Clear debris and spin the fan freely; reconnect the motor plug.
solutions.ur: Debris hata kar fan ko azaad ghumayein; motor plug dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor fan motor, or the outdoor PCB if drive output is missing.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor badlein, ya drive output na ho to outdoor PCB badlein

meaning.en: Input current exceeded the allowed limit at the outdoor unit.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit par input current mujarraba se zyada ho gaya

causes.en: Power-supply voltage out of specification; outdoor temperature out of operating range.
causes.ur: Power supply voltage specification ke bahar; outdoor temperature bhi operating range se bahar

causes.en: Short circuit in the drive/compressor circuit.
causes.ur: Drive/compressor circuit mein short

causes.en: Defective outdoor PCB, compressor, or power module.
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB, compressor ya power module kharab

solutions.en: Verify supply voltage and ambient conditions are within ratings.
solutions.ur: Supply voltage aur mahol ki conditions ratings ke andar hain ya nahi check karein

solutions.en: Megger/short-test compressor and inverter wiring; repair shorts.
solutions.ur: Compressor aur inverter wiring ka megger/short test karein; short theek karein

solutions.en: Replace the power module, compressor, or outdoor PCB as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabiq power module, compressor ya outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Regional official pages list E8 as 'OVERCURRENT INPUT'.
notes.ur: Regional official pages E8 ko 'OVERCURRENT INPUT' kehta hain.

meaning.en: The four-way reversing valve did not operate or its circuit is faulty.
meaning.ur: Four-way reversing valve ne kaam nahi kiya ya uski circuit kharab hai

causes.en: Four-way valve coil disconnected or coil/valve/harness defective.
causes.ur: Four-way valve ki coil khuli ya coil/valve/harness kharab

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage, moisture in circuit, or closed stop valve.
causes.ur: Refrigerant ki kami, circuit mein namak, ya band stop valve

causes.en: Defective outdoor PCB or associated thermistor.
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ya us se juri hui thermistor kharab

solutions.en: Check coil continuity and reconnect/replace the coil or valve.
solutions.ur: Coil ki continuity check karein aur coil ya valve dobara lagayein/badlein

solutions.en: Open stop valves; leak-test and recharge; replace outdoor PCB if needed.
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein; leak test karke gas bharrein; zarurat ho to outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: FTXC-C calls it '4 way valve error'.
notes.ur: FTXC-C isay '4 way valve error' kehta hai.

meaning.en: Compressor discharge temperature rose past the safety limit and the unit stopped.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki discharge temperature safety limit se upar chali gayi aur unit ruk gayi

causes.en: Defective discharge-pipe thermistor (or outdoor heat-exchanger / outdoor-air thermistor).
causes.ur: Discharge pipe thermistor kharab (ya outdoor heat exchanger / outdoor air ka thermistor)

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage, closed stop valve, or defective expansion valve/coil.
causes.ur: Refrigerant ki kami, band stop valve, ya kharab expansion valve/coil

causes.en: Defective four-way valve, moisture in refrigerant, or outdoor PCB fault.
causes.ur: Four-way valve kharab, refrigerant mein namak, ya outdoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check/replace the discharge thermistor; confirm sensors read sanely.
solutions.ur: Discharge thermistor check/badlein; sensors ki readings theek hain ya nahi confirm karein

solutions.en: Open stop valves, clean the circuit, leak-test and recharge to spec.
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein, circuit saaf karein, leak test karke zaruri miqdar ke mutabiq gas bharrein

solutions.en: Verify EXV operation; replace four-way valve or outdoor PCB as required.
solutions.ur: EXV ka kaam check karein; zarurat ke mutabiq four-way valve ya outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: On RAC remotes F3 is one of the first codes in the ARC433B cycle.
notes.ur: RAC remotes par F3 ARC433B cycle ke pehle codes mein se ek hai.

meaning.en: High-pressure protection activated during cooling operation.
meaning.ur: Cooling ke doran high pressure protection active hua

causes.en: Insufficient clearance around the outdoor unit or dirty outdoor heat exchanger.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ke aas paas jagah kam ya outdoor heat exchanger gandi

causes.en: Defective outdoor fan motor or closed stop valve.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor kharab ya stop valve band

causes.en: Defective EXV/coil, outdoor heat-exchanger thermistor, or outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: EXV/coil, outdoor heat exchanger thermistor ya outdoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Restore required clearance and wash the outdoor condenser.
solutions.ur: Zaroori khaali jagah bana kar outdoor condenser dhoyein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor fan motor; open stop valves.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor badal dein aur stop valves kholein.

solutions.en: Check EXV and thermistors; replace outdoor PCB if all are healthy.
solutions.ur: EXV aur thermistor check karein; sab theek hon to outdoor PCB badlein

meaning.en: A compressor-related sensor signal (position/feedback family) was invalid.
meaning.ur: Compressor se juray sensor ka signal (position/feedback family) ghalat tha

causes.en: Broken or disconnected sensor harness.
causes.ur: Sensor harness tooti ya disconnect ho gayi

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Trace and repair/replace the sensor harness.
solutions.ur: Sensor harness ko dhoond kar theek karein ya badlein

solutions.en: If harness is sound, replace the outdoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Harness theek ho to outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: SM-TS3 H0 = 'malfunction of sensor system of compressor'.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein H0 ka matlab hai 'malfunction of sensor system of compressor'.

meaning.en: Rotor position feedback from the compressor is faulty, so operation halted.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki rotor position ka feedback kharab hai, is liye chalna rok diya gaya

causes.en: Start-up attempted with stop valve closed; supply voltage out of range.
causes.ur: Stop valve band hone par unit ko chalaane ki koshish; supply voltage had se bahar

causes.en: Disconnection of the compressor relay cable.
causes.ur: Compressor relay cable disconnect

causes.en: Defective compressor or outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Compressor ya outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Open the stop valves fully before restarting.
solutions.ur: Dobara chalane se pehle stop valves poori tarah kholein

solutions.en: Check supply voltage and relay-cable connections.
solutions.ur: Supply voltage aur relay-cable connections check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the compressor or outdoor PCB per diagnosis.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabiq compressor ya outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Regional pages: 'operation halt due to faulty position detection sensor'.
notes.ur: Regional pages par likha hai: 'operation halt due to faulty position detection sensor'.

meaning.en: The compressor current-sensing (CT) circuit reported an invalid value.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki current-sensing (CT) circuit ne ghalat value batayi.

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB (CT circuit).
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB (CT circuit) kharab hai.

causes.en: SM-TS3 also points to defective power transistor, reactor, or faulty inverter wiring.
causes.ur: SM-TS3 mein yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke power transistor, reactor ya inverter wiring kharab ho sakti hai

solutions.en: Inspect inverter wiring, reactor and power transistor connections.
solutions.ur: Inverter ki wiring, reactor aur power transistor connections check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor PCB if the CT circuit remains faulty.
solutions.ur: CT circuit kharab rahe to outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Service manual marks H8 as 35/42 class only.
notes.ur: Service manual mein H8 sirf 35/42 class ke liye marked hai.

meaning.en: The outdoor-air temperature sensor read out of range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor air ke temperature sensor ki reading had se bahar hai

causes.en: Thermistor connector not properly connected.
causes.ur: Thermistor connector theek se nahi laga hua

causes.en: Defective outdoor-air thermistor.
causes.ur: Outdoor air ka thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the thermistor connector and retest.
solutions.ur: Thermistor connector dobara laga kar dobara test karein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor if resistance is off; otherwise replace outdoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Resistance ghalat ho to thermistor badlein, warna outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: FTXC-C: 'Outdoor air thermistor short/open'.
notes.ur: FTXC-C mein yeh likha hai: 'Outdoor air thermistor short/open'.

meaning.en: The compressor discharge-pipe temperature sensor read out of range.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki discharge pipe temperature sensor ghalat reading de rahi hai

causes.en: Thermistor connector not connected.
causes.ur: Thermistor connector nahi laga hua

causes.en: Defective discharge pipe thermistor.
causes.ur: Discharge pipe thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reconnect and verify the sensor resistance vs temperature chart.
solutions.ur: Dobara lagayein aur sensor ka resistance temperature chart se check karein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor; replace outdoor PCB only if sensor tests OK.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein; outdoor PCB sirf tab badlein jab sensor theek nikle

notes.en: FTXC-C adds 'misplaced' (sensor not seated in pocket).
notes.ur: FTXC-C mein 'misplaced' bhi shamil hai (sensor pocket mein baitha nahi hai).

title.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger thermistor kharab hai

meaning.en: The outdoor coil temperature sensor read out of range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil ke temperature sensor ki reading had se bahar hai

causes.en: Thermistor connector not connected.
causes.ur: Thermistor connector nahi laga hua

causes.en: Defective outdoor heat exchanger thermistor.
causes.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger thermistor kharab hai.

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the connector; check resistance against the chart.
solutions.ur: Connector dobara lagayein; chart ke mutabiq resistance check karein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor or, if it tests good, the outdoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein, ya woh theek nikle to outdoor PCB badlein

title.ur: Electrical parts box ki temperature barhna

meaning.en: Temperature inside the outdoor electrical parts box rose too high.
meaning.ur: Outdoor electrical parts box ke andar ki temperature bohat zyada ho gayi

causes.en: Defective outdoor fan motor or short circuit causing extra heat.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor kharab ya short circuit ki wajah se zyada garmi

causes.en: Defective radiation-fin thermistor or disconnected connector.
causes.ur: Radiation fin thermistor kharab ya connector disconnect

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor fan motor; find and clear the short.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor badlein; short dhoond kar khatam karein

solutions.en: Check fin thermistor/connector; replace outdoor PCB if needed.
solutions.ur: Fin thermistor/connector check karein; zarurat ho to outdoor PCB badlein

title.ur: Inverter radiation fin (heatsink) ki temperature barhna

meaning.en: The inverter heatsink overheated.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka heatsink zyada garam ho gaya

causes.en: Defective outdoor fan motor or short circuit.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor kharab ya short circuit

causes.en: Defective radiation fin thermistor or loose connector.
causes.ur: Radiation fin thermistor kharab ya connector dhila

causes.en: Silicon grease not applied properly after outdoor PCB replacement.
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB badalne ke baad silicon grease theek se nahi lagayi gayi

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Restore outdoor fan operation and clear airflow around the heatsink.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan chalana theek karein aur heatsink ke aas paas se hawa ka raasta saaf karein

solutions.en: Re-apply proper silicon grease / replace fin thermistor; replace PCB if required.
solutions.ur: Sahi silicon grease lagayein ya fin thermistor badlein; zarurat ho to PCB badlein

meaning.en: Inverter output current spiked beyond the safe limit.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke output current muhafaz ki had se upar chala gaya

causes.en: Poor installation conditions or abnormal supply voltage.
causes.ur: Kharab installation ya ghalat supply voltage

causes.en: Closed stop valve, wrong internal wiring, or defective power module.
causes.ur: Band stop valve, ghalat internal wiring, ya kharab power module

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB or compressor.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB ya compressor kharab

solutions.en: Open the stop valves; correct internal wiring and supply voltage.
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein; andarooni wiring aur supply voltage theek karein.

solutions.en: Replace the power module; megger the compressor windings.
solutions.ur: Power module badlein; compressor windings ka megger test karein

solutions.en: Replace the compressor or outdoor PCB if the fault persists.
solutions.ur: Fault phir bhi rahe to compressor ya outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Regional pages: 'OUTPUT OVERCURRENT'; FTXC-C: 'IPM error / IGBT error'.
notes.ur: Regional pages par 'OUTPUT OVERCURRENT' likha hai; FTXC-C mein 'IPM error / IGBT error'.

meaning.en: The inverter heatsink temperature sensor read out of range.
meaning.ur: Inverter heatsink ke temperature sensor ki reading had se bahar hai

causes.en: Thermistor connector not connected.
causes.ur: Thermistor connector nahi laga hua

causes.en: Defective radiation fin thermistor.
causes.ur: Radiation fin thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective inverter/outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter/outdoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reconnect the sensor and verify reading.
solutions.ur: Sensor dobara lagayein aur reading check karein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor; replace the PCB only if the sensor is good.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein; PCB sirf tab badlein jab sensor theek ho

notes.en: Present on all official RAC lists (India, FTXC-C, web-manual, SM-TS3).
notes.ur: Yeh sab official RAC lists par maujood hai (India, FTXC-C, web-manual, SM-TS3).
